stem: An adult is prescribed oral azithromycin for mild community-acquired pneumonia using the labeled 5-day regimen. Which schedule matches the prescribing information?

options.A: 500 mg on day 1, then 250 mg once daily on days 2 through 5
options.D: 250 mg on day 1, then increase the dose each day

rationale: Current DailyMed labeling lists 500 mg as a single dose on day 1 followed by 250 mg once daily on days 2 through 5 for adult mild community-acquired pneumonia.
educational_objective: Identify the labeled 5-day oral azithromycin regimen for adult mild community-acquired pneumonia.
source_locator: Dosage and Administration, Section 2.1 > Adult Patients > Community-acquired pneumonia (mild severity)
source_claim_supported: For adult mild community-acquired pneumonia, the labeled regimen is 500 mg day 1 then 250 mg daily days 2–5.
blueprint_locator: 2026 NCLEX-RN Test Plan, Pharmacological and Parenteral Therapies, printed p.12 / PDF p.16
correction_summary: Replaced the ambiguous phrase “standard Z-pack” with a specific labeled indication because azithromycin has multiple indication-specific dosing regimens; removed the unsupported causal explanation about half-life.
audit_findings: A exactly matches the labeled table. B–D do not. No second answer remains.
audit_reviewer: GPT-5.6 Sol Rule 1 — final semantic audit
final_reaudit_scope: source authority/currentness/exact locator; claim-by-claim; all distractors; ambiguity/second-answer/cueing; correction; re-audit; NCSBN 2026 blueprint; independent second-pass
